# Help and support

- Start with the [website and user guide](https://pascalnun.eu/tools/rhinospatial/).
- Read [Working with project data](../docs/WORKING_WITH_PROJECT_DATA.md) for source choices, coordinates and common messages.
- See the [component reference](../docs/COMPONENT_REFERENCE.md) for formats, inputs, coordinate behavior and diagnostics.
- Try the [Grasshopper examples](../examples/README.md).
- Download the recommended version from [GitHub Latest](https://github.com/PascalNun/RhinoSpatial/releases/latest), [Food4Rhino](https://www.food4rhino.com/en/app/rhinospatial) or Rhino 8's Package Manager.
- Report reproducible bugs or propose improvements through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/PascalNun/RhinoSpatial/issues/new/choose).

Include the component's full Status output and a small public test source where possible. Remove API keys, passwords and private data before sharing a definition or screenshot. Provider-specific service changes and unusual file metadata may require a compatibility fix.

The public package is 0.4.0. Features added on `main` need a development build; check the guides' release labels when an example uses a format that your installed version does not accept.
